summary.text: Jerome Amos is a Democratic state representative who has represented Iowa House District 62 since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists Amos's career experience as an adjunct instructor and machinist and notes service on the Waterloo city council.

paragraphs.text: Jerome Amos Jr.'s career experience includes working as an adjunct instructor with Hawkeye Community College and as a machinist with John Deere, according to Ballotpedia.
Amos served on the city council of Waterloo, Iowa.
In the 2025-2026 session Amos was assigned to the House Appropriations, Labor, Public Safety and House Veterans Affairs committees.
